# EverythingRated

> Multi-axis rating tool for structured directories and catalogs — decisions with explicit trade-offs, not star averages.

## When to use this

- Comparing AI dev tools across multiple rating axes instead of a single collapsed score
- Checking community ratings for coding agents, code review tools, and dev infrastructure
- Getting structured multi-aspect ratings data as JSON for agent consumption
- Reading the product brief as markdown without JavaScript

## Product

- [Home](https://ratings.highsignal.app/): Directories and ratings

## Developer docs

- [OpenAPI spec](https://ratings.highsignal.app/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract for all agent surfaces
- [Agent catalog](https://ratings.highsignal.app/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [Full agent brief](https://ratings.highsignal.app/llms-full.txt): Expanded product facts and capabilities
- [Homepage markdown](https://ratings.highsignal.app/index.md): Product brief without JS

## CLI

- API base URL: `https://ratings.highsignal.app`
- Fetch the agent catalog: `curl https://ratings.highsignal.app/api/ai`
- Fetch the OpenAPI spec: `curl https://ratings.highsignal.app/openapi.json`
- Get homepage as markdown: `curl -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://ratings.highsignal.app/`

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://ratings.highsignal.app/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://ratings.highsignal.app/openapi.json): Machine-readable API contract
- [Homepage markdown](https://ratings.highsignal.app/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://ratings.highsignal.app/llms.txt)
